record.title: India–Bangladesh land-trade interruption during August 2024 unrest
record.crossings: Petrapole–Benapole; Hili; Changrabandha; Mahadipur; Fulbari; Gojadanga
record.exceptions: Some West Bengal ports resumed limited perishable-goods trade August 7
record.imposing_authority: Port authorities / security conditions on both sides
record.enforcement: Local port and PTI reports describe actual resumed freight, with Petrapole later than other West Bengal ports.
record.consequences: Cargo trade interrupted; loss estimates in local reports not adopted as verified totals.
record.status_observation: actual reopening dated 2024-08-08; no inference of present status
record.official_rationale: Lack of security during unrest and collapse of Sheikh Hasina’s government.
record.context: Lack of security during unrest and collapse of Sheikh Hasina’s government.
record.uncertainty: Endpoint is observed Petrapole–Benapole resumption; not proof every Bangladesh land port reopened. Authority differs across locations; de facto operational stoppage included.
